title: Tesla's Digital Optimus Plays Halfway Through Diablo in General AI Trial
summary:
Elon Musk revealed that the company's Digital Optimus AI can now navigate video game environments using purely visual data from the screen. The system has successfully completed approximately half of the Diablo game campaign, demonstrates proficiency in fast-paced titles such as Counter-Strike, and is currently undergoing training to play League of Legends.

The objective of these tests is to enable the AI to generalize its capabilities across all types of video games. By processing visual input rather than utilizing internal game-state data, Tesla is testing whether the system can interact with software in a manner identical to a human user.
